seasonRead.headline: 2025–26: High-touch creation sets the attack; balance makes the line work
paragraphs: High-Touch Risk/Reward Scorer owns the majority of the forward map. The combination of scoring, extended possessions and giveaways describes offensive burden: these players are asked to make more plays, including the difficult ones that sometimes fail.

Two-Way Skill Scorer adds takeaways and playmaking, but it should not be mistaken for automatic defensive suppression. Its value in this mix is connective: a second decision-maker who can keep the attack from stalling around one high-touch creator.

seasonRead.headline: 2025–26: The blue line keeps several answers in the bag
paragraphs: Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman is only a plurality, and its blocks reflect own-zone labor as much as defensive success. Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman supplies the clearest production-and-distribution alternative.

Defensive Role Defenseman is too broad to carry a literal defensive claim, while Physical Shutdown Defenseman owns the more credible physical specialty. The season’s hockey story is specialization: one pair can advance, another can absorb pressure and a third can impose contact without any single job swallowing the blue line.
